== Original and remastered English issuer text ==
The remaster makes the three stacked cards face-up and restates the one-card choice during battle. The period One Rule limits the singular on-table action to once per battle per copy. Both slips leave the title unrestricted. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16603#page=1 Players Committee original sheet, p. 1, slip 8].
